article: Create Graphs with the CS Academy Graph Editor
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, graph-theory meaning and terminology, the saved graph image, internal and external links, metadata, and the official CS Academy announcement. Checked the current tool URL with text-only browsing.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates and kept the original publication date 2022-10-13; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Rewrote all locales to consistently describe mathematical graphs (vertices and edges), not charts or data plots; removed unsupported claims that the service is free.
Clarified the article’s saved-image example and the Directed and Download as PNG labels.

Added a dated limitation in every locale: the current page returned a JavaScript-required response to text-only browsing, so current UI and feature behavior could not be verified. Added the tool URL and CS Academy’s original announcement.
